title: Claude Duet alternative: pi-durable-bot (Pots), open source
description: An open-source alternative to Claude Duet: pi-durable-bot (Pots) is an AI coworker that acts on its own in your team's chat apps, with any model.
claim: An AI coworker that acts on its own inside your team's chat apps, with the model you choose.
answer: pi-durable-bot (Pots) is an open-source AI coworker that decides when to act and works on its own computer. Claude Duet is Anthropic's proactive agent in its own app, as a US-only preview. The difference: Pots runs on any machine you choose, with any model, in your team's chat apps.

rivalIs.text: Claude Duet is Anthropic's app where Claude works as a proactive agent for professionals and small business owners. It runs on a cloud VM with its own browser, checks your connected accounts every few hours, and asks before it acts for you. It is a US-only research preview, by waitlist.

table.note: Claude Duet cells: Anthropic's public pages, checked 2026-11-10. Your data: with a local model for the agent and the judge, nothing leaves your machine; with a hosted model, requests go to the provider you chose.

rows.label: Model
rows.pots: Any: your subscription, 40+ providers, or a local model

rows.label: Where you talk to it
rows.pots: Any channel (Slack, Discord, Telegram, and more)
rows.rival: Its own app, and the web

rows.label: Your data
rows.pots: On your machine, in each bot's folder

rows.pots: As they arrive; a mention wakes it at once
rows.rival: Checks connected accounts every few hours

rows.label: Price
rows.pots: Free (MIT). You bring the machine and the model
rows.rival: Included in Pro, Max and Ultra during the preview

pickRival: You want a phone app that brings you a brief each morning.
You already pay for Claude Pro, Max or Ultra, in the US.
You want 6,000+ connectors and plugins from the Claude Marketplace.
You want it to ask before it sends, pays, signs or deletes.
pickPots: You want it in your team's channels, not in a separate app.
You want to choose the model, or run a local one.
You want the code, on a machine you choose.
You are outside the US, or do not want to wait.

faq.a: No. Anthropic's pages offer no source code or self-hosted version; Duet runs on a cloud VM the maker hosts.

faq.q: Can Pots use my Claude subscription?
faq.a: Yes. `pots login` can sign in with a Claude subscription you already pay for, and Pots can run Claude Opus 5.5 or any other model pi supports.

No. The other products as their makers described them in public, checked 2026-11-10; they may have changed since. Grok Bot, dots, Claude Duet, Claude Tag and Muse are products of SpaceXSI, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. pi-durable-bot is not affiliated with any of them.
